title: Antarctica as the Nordics' main subterranean base

tellings.quote: the principal subterranean submarine location for these Nordics who we discussed in our first conversation is Antarctica.

plain: Antarctica is said to be the main underground and undersea base of the "Nordics", a human-looking group of beings that some UFO stories describe. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says this to Michels in his own words, without naming a source, and refers back to an earlier conversation the two had about these beings. If true, it would put a hidden non-human presence beneath the ice of the far south.
